__title: Free Report-Book AI – IHK-compliant in seconds
__metaDescription: Forgot your report book? This free AI generator turns simple notes into IHK-compliant weekly training records. No sign-up, runs in your browser.

sbEntryTitle.nicht_alles_gehoert_ins_ber: Not everything belongs in your report book.
app.dein_berichtsheft_unterschreibt_dein: Your company signs your report book. Some things are hard to put in there.
app.was_du_gelernt_hast_ausbilder: What you learned. Your trainer and the IHK read along.
app.was_schiefgelaufen_ist_nur_du: What went wrong. Only you can open it.
app.ueberstunden_die_niemand_aufschreibt: Overtime nobody writes down. Tasks that have nothing to do with your trade. Remarks that stopped being jokes. If you later want to take it up with your trainer, the trainee representatives, the IHK or a lawyer, one thing counts above all: that you wrote it down back then — with a date.
app.beim_ersten_oeffnen_legst_du: You set a password the first time you open it. Everything is encrypted with it on your device — if you forget it, the entries are gone.
umfrageBanner.kurze_frage_zur_zukunft_de: Quick question about the app's future
umfrageBanner.die_zeiterfassung_bleibt_k: Time tracking stays free. But would a stronger AI for the report book be worth something to you? Two questions, no sign-up.
umfForm.zeiterfassung_cloudsync_auswertu:
Time tracking, cloud sync, reports and the PDF export stay free —
                        nothing changes there. Only the AI that writes your report book costs
                        money on an ongoing basis. So this is only about that. The points below are
                        ideas — none of it exists yet.
umfForm.wie_oft_schreibst_du_gerade: How often do you currently write in your report book?
umfForm.was_waere_dir_beim_kiberichtshef: What would be worth money to you for the AI report book?
umfForm.und_wie_oft_wenn_es: And how often, if you got what you checked?
umfForm.eine_antwort_ehrlich_geschaetzt_: One answer — an honest guess, even if nothing changes
umfForm.was_waere_dir_das_im: What would that be worth to you per month?
umfForm.es_werden_nur_diese_vier: Only these four answers are transmitted. No name, no email, no entries. None of it is binding.
umfFeatures.formulierungen_die_du_so_ueb: Wording you can use as-is instead of rebuilding it
umfFeatures.lernt_aus_deinen_bisherigen_: Learns from your previous weeks so it doesn't sound like a machine
umfFeatures.prueft_ob_die_woche_zum: Checks whether the week matches the training framework plan and holds up to your trainer
umfFeatures.ganzen_monat_in_einem_durchl: A whole month in one go instead of week by week
umfFeatures.so_oft_neu_generieren_wie: Regenerate as often as you want, no wait
umfFeatures.die_ki_soll_bleiben_wie: The AI should stay as it is, free
umfDone.das_hilft_mir_bei_der: This helps me decide. Whatever the outcome: time tracking itself stays free.
freigabeSub.waehle_die_wochen_die_dein: Pick the weeks your trainer should sign off.
freigabeModal.normalerweise_scannst_du_s: Normally you just scan their response code with your phone camera. If they sent you the link instead, you can paste it here.
freigabeModal.die_woche_steckt_im_link: The week is contained in the link itself and is not uploaded. An approval locks the entry here — you can always unlock it yourself, but that discards the approval.
reportInstruction.unterweisungen_betrieb: Instruction, in-house lessons, other training — its own block on the IHK form
fotoTitle.foto_vom_papierberichtsheft: Photo of your paper report book
fotoImport.texterkennung_laeuft_auf_dein: Text recognition runs on your device - the image is not uploaded
fotoStepStart.am_handy_oeffnet_sich_dire: On a phone the camera opens straight away
fotoStepStart.beim_ersten_mal_wird_die: The first time, text recognition is fetched from the network once (a few megabytes). After that it runs offline.
fotoStepStart.was_herauskommt_ist_ein_vo: What comes out is a proposal. It lands in the weekly form, where you check it - only there is it saved.
fotoStepBusy.das_dauert_je_nach_geraet: This takes a few seconds depending on your device. The image stays on it throughout.
fotoHinweis.es_liess_sich_kein_wochentag: No weekday could be identified. The recognised text is in the raw text below - you can copy it into the day fields from there.
advancedCollapse.bestimmt_auch_aus_welch: Also decides which week the tracked hours are pulled from.
advancedCollapse.laeuft_ohne_einrichtung: Runs with no setup, no API key of your own. The model only receives your occupation, training year and your notes — no names, no reports, no identifiers.
advancedCollapse.aus_es_schreibt_die_lok: Off: the local engine writes instead — no daily limit and nothing leaves your device.

aiStudioPanel.so_sieht_ein_montag_damit: How a Monday reads with this
aiStudioPanel.was_hier_steht_hat_vorrang: Whatever you write here overrides the writing style above. Works with cloud AI only.
aisFormHint.zb_praesens_statt_perfekt_od: e.g. "present tense, not past" or "exactly 4 lines per day"
aisCustomPrompt.einfach_hinschreiben_zb_: Just write it down — e.g. "Mon: swapped out old machines, set up Windows. Tue: worked through tickets. Fri: vocational school, topic networking"
